projects.name: P&G – SharePoint Site Design & Configuration
details: • Worked on designing and configuring modern SharePoint Online sites aligned with P&G branding
and business needs.
• Created and customized site pages using out-of-the-box (OOB) web parts like Hero, Quick Links, and
People. Configured navigation, permissions, and layout for enhanced usability.
• Documented configuration steps and ensured consistent site design and functionality.
• Enhanced user navigation by creating global and hub navigations, modern layouts, and reusable
page/site templates.
• Conducted rigorous testing and validation to ensure smooth deployment in pre -production and
production environments.

projects.name: SBLI – SharePoint Online DMS Modernization
details: • Contributed to the modernization of SBLI’s on-premise Document Management System (DMS) into a
scalable SharePoint Online solution.
• Focused on metadata -driven document management, Power Automate integration, and SPFx -based
dashboard development for document tracking and compliance.
• Designed document libraries, metadata, and content types for scalability.
• Developed SPFx dashboards and forms integrated with SharePoint lists.
• Implemented Power Automate flows for upload and version notifications.
• Participated in testing and bug-fixing during deployment phases.
• Prepared technical documentation and user guides for deployed solutions.
